#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PYPL Programming Language Popularity Index — April 2026 poster. v3 final."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math

W, H = 2400, 3600
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#0B0F1A")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

FONTS = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

BG_CARD  = "#111827"
BG_ROW1  = "#141B2D"
BG_ROW2  = "#0F1523"
BLUE     = "#3B82F6"
BLUE_DIM = "#1E3A5F"
BLUE_VDK = "#0F2340"
GREEN    = "#22C55E"
RED      = "#EF4444"
WHITE    = "#F1F5F9"
GRAY     = "#94A3B8"
GRAY_DIM = "#475569"
ACCENT   = "#60A5FA"

def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FONTS}/{name}", size)

f_hero_title = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 148)
f_title      = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 92)
f_subtitle   = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
f_stat_big   = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 120)
f_stat_ctx   = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_rank_num   = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_lang       = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48)
f_share      = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 48)
f_trend      = font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_section    = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 58)
f_section_sm = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_small      = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_tiny       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 23)
f_date       = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_emg_val    = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_emg_label  = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 34)
f_emg_note   = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_5yr_num    = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_5yr_lang   = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)
f_mover_name = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_mover_val  = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 32)
f_key_num    = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 96)
f_key_label  = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_col_hdr    = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_method     = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 25)
f_quote      = font("InstrumentSerif-Italic.ttf", 36)

M = 120  # margin

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill)

def tr(x, y, txt, f, fill=WHITE):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=f)
    draw.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0]), y), txt, font=f, fill=fill)

def tc(cx, y, txt, f, fill=WHITE):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=f)
    draw.text((cx - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y), txt, font=f, fill=fill)

def tcol(v):
    return GREEN if v > 0 else RED if v < 0 else GRAY

def ts(v):
    return f"+{v}%" if v > 0 else f"{v}%"

# ===== SUBTLE BACKGROUND GRID =====
for gx in range(0, W, 120):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill="#0D1220", width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 120):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill="#0D1220", width=1)

# ===== TOP ACCENT =====
for x in range(W):
    t = x / W
    r = int(59 * (1-t) + 34 * t)
    g = int(130 * (1-t) + 197 * t)
    b = int(246 * (1-t) + 94 * t)
    draw.rectangle([x, 0, x+1, 6], fill=f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}")

# ===== HEADER =====
y = 48
draw.text((M, y), "PYPL", font=f_hero_title, fill=BLUE)
bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), "PYPL", font=f_hero_title)
px = M + (bb[2]-bb[0]) + 28
draw.text((px, y + 10), "PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE", font=f_title, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((px, y + 100), "POPULARITY INDEX", font=f_title, fill=WHITE)
tr(W - M, y + 10, "APRIL 2026", f_date, ACCENT)
tr(W - M, y + 50, "WORLDWIDE DATA", f_tiny, GRAY_DIM)

y_sep = 270
draw.rectangle([M, y_sep, W - M, y_sep + 2], fill=BLUE_DIM)
draw.text((M, y_sep + 18), "Google Trends tutorial search share \u2014 a leading indicator of language adoption", font=f_subtitle, fill=GRAY)

# ===== HERO STAT CARDS =====
y_hero = 350
card_w = (W - 2*M - 60) // 3
cards = [
    ("PYTHON", "36.21%", "+5.7% YoY", GREEN, "#1 WORLDWIDE"),
    ("C/C++",  "13.21%", "+6.2% YoY", GREEN, "#2 WORLDWIDE"),
    ("JAVA",   "10.01%", "\u22125.4% YoY", RED,   "#3 WORLDWIDE"),
]

for i, (name, val, trend, col, rank) in enumerate(cards):
    cx = M + i * (card_w + 30)
    rr(cx, y_hero, card_w, 290, 16, BG_CARD)
    # glow accent
    for g in range(6):
        alpha = 40 - g * 6
        draw.rectangle([cx+8, y_hero+g, cx+card_w-8, y_hero+g+1], fill=col+f"{alpha:02x}")
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+24), rank, font=f_tiny, fill=GRAY_DIM)
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+54), name, font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+130), val, font=f_stat_big, fill=col)
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+248), trend, font=f_stat_ctx, fill=col)

# ===== TOP 10 TABLE =====
y_t = y_hero + 340
draw.text((M, y_t), "TOP 10 LANGUAGES", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((M + 520, y_t + 12), "BY SEARCH SHARE", font=f_body, fill=GRAY_DIM)

y_hdr = y_t + 76
draw.text((M+12, y_hdr), "#", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M+85, y_hdr), "LANGUAGE", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M+520, y_hdr), "SHARE", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M+790, y_hdr), "DISTRIBUTION", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
tr(W-M-18, y_hdr, "1Y TREND", f_col_hdr, GRAY_DIM)
draw.rectangle([M, y_hdr+36, W-M, y_hdr+37], fill=BLUE_DIM)

data = [
    (1,"Python",36.21,5.7),(2,"C/C++",13.21,6.2),(3,"Java",10.01,-5.4),
    (4,"R",6.17,1.6),(5,"JavaScript",5.07,-3.0),(6,"Swift",3.15,0.8),
    (7,"C#",3.00,-3.0),(8,"Rust",2.98,-0.1),(9,"PHP",2.96,-0.7),
    (10,"Objective-C",2.57,0.1),
]

row_h = 82
bar_max = 520
y_row = y_hdr + 48

for rank, lang, share, trend in data:
    bg = BG_ROW1 if rank % 2 == 1 else BG_ROW2
    rr(M, y_row, W-2*M, row_h-6, 10, bg)
    c = tcol(trend)
    # left accent
    draw.rectangle([M, y_row+8, M+4, y_row+row_h-14], fill=c)
    draw.text((M+18, y_row+14), f"{rank:>2}", font=f_rank_num, fill=GRAY_DIM)
    draw.text((M+95, y_row+14), lang, font=f_lang, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((M+500, y_row+16), f"{share:.2f}%", font=f_share, fill=WHITE)
    # bar
    bw = int((share/36.21)*bar_max)
    bx, by, bh = M+780, y_row+22, 34
    rr(bx, by, bar_max, bh, 7, "#1a2236")
    if bw > 14:
        rr(bx, by, bw, bh, 7, c+"35")
        draw.rectangle([bx+3, by+3, bx+bw-3, by+bh-3], fill=c+"60")
        draw.rectangle([bx+bw-4, by+4, bx+bw-1, by+bh-4], fill=c+"cc")
    tr(W-M-18, y_row+18, ts(trend), f_trend, c)
    y_row += row_h

y_post_table = y_row + 14
draw.rectangle([M, y_post_table, W-M, y_post_table+2], fill=BLUE_DIM)

# ===== 5-YEAR SPOTLIGHT =====
y5 = y_post_table + 30
draw.text((M, y5), "5-YEAR TREND SPOTLIGHT", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
y5c = y5 + 78
hw = (W-2*M-50)//2

for i, (title, lang, val, col, desc) in enumerate([
    ("BIGGEST 5-YEAR GAINER", "C/C++", "+7.0%", GREEN, "Largest cumulative growth of any tracked language"),
    ("BIGGEST 5-YEAR LOSER", "JAVA", "\u22127.0%", RED, "Steepest cumulative decline of any tracked language"),
]):
    cx = M + i * (hw + 50)
    rr(cx, y5c, hw, 200, 16, BG_CARD)
    for g in range(5):
        a = 35 - g*6
        draw.rectangle([cx+8, y5c+g, cx+hw-8, y5c+g+1], fill=col+f"{a:02x}")
    draw.text((cx+30, y5c+22), title, font=f_tiny, fill=GRAY_DIM)
    draw.text((cx+30, y5c+56), lang, font=f_5yr_lang, fill=WHITE)
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), lang, font=f_5yr_lang)
    draw.text((cx+40+(bb[2]-bb[0]), y5c+56), val, font=f_5yr_num, fill=col)
    draw.text((cx+30, y5c+150), desc, font=f_small, fill=GRAY)

# ===== BIGGEST MOVERS =====
y_gl = y5c + 240
draw.text((M, y_gl), "BIGGEST MOVERS", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((M+430, y_gl+12), "YEAR-OVER-YEAR CHANGE", font=f_body, fill=GRAY_DIM)

movers = [("C/C++",6.2),("Python",5.7),("R",1.6),("Ada",1.1),("Swift",0.8)]
losers = [("Java",-5.4),("JavaScript",-3.0),("C#",-3.0),("Go",-1.3),("Kotlin",-0.9)]

y_mv = y_gl + 72
chw = (W-2*M-60)//2
lx2 = M + chw + 60
draw.text((M+12, y_mv), "GAINERS", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GREEN)
draw.text((lx2+12, y_mv), "LOSERS", font=f_col_hdr, fill=RED)

ym = y_mv + 40
for i in range(5):
    gn, gv = movers[i]
    bw = int((gv/6.2)*(chw-260))
    rr(M, ym-4, chw, 48, 8, BG_ROW1)
    draw.text((M+14, ym+4), gn, font=f_mover_name, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((M+180, ym+4), f"+{gv}%", font=f_mover_val, fill=GREEN)
    rr(M+290, ym+10, bw, 24, 5, GREEN+"44")
    draw.rectangle([M+292, ym+13, M+290+bw-2, ym+31], fill=GREEN+"77")

    ln, lv = losers[i]
    bw2 = int((abs(lv)/6.2)*(chw-260))
    rr(lx2, ym-4, chw, 48, 8, BG_ROW1)
    draw.text((lx2+14, ym+4), ln, font=f_mover_name, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((lx2+180, ym+4), f"{lv}%", font=f_mover_val, fill=RED)
    rr(lx2+290, ym+10, bw2, 24, 5, RED+"44")
    draw.rectangle([lx2+292, ym+13, lx2+290+bw2-2, ym+31], fill=RED+"77")
    ym += 56

# ===== LANGUAGES TO WATCH =====
y_w = ym + 30
draw.rectangle([M, y_w, W-M, y_w+2], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_w += 24
draw.text((M, y_w), "LANGUAGES TO WATCH", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)

emerging = [
    ("Ada","2.51%","+1.1%","Safety-critical systems"),
    ("Julia","0.73%","+0.4%","Scientific computing"),
    ("Go","0.71%","-1.3%","Cloud-native declining"),
    ("Kotlin","0.90%","-0.9%","Android-backed decline"),
    ("Zig","0.24%","+0.0%","Niche systems language"),
]

y_em = y_w + 76
ecw = (W-2*M-80)//5
for i,(lang,share,trend,note) in enumerate(emerging):
    ex = M + i*(ecw+20)
    rr(ex, y_em, ecw, 140, 12, BG_CARD)
    c = GREEN if "+" in trend and trend!="+0.0%" else RED if "-" in trend else GRAY
    draw.ellipse([ex+16, y_em+18, ex+28, y_em+30], fill=c)
    draw.text((ex+36, y_em+12), lang, font=f_emg_label, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((ex+18, y_em+56), share, font=f_emg_val, fill=ACCENT)
    tr(ex+ecw-18, y_em+56, trend, f_emg_val, c)
    draw.text((ex+18, y_em+96), note, font=f_emg_note, fill=GRAY_DIM)

# ===== KEY NUMBERS =====
y_kn = y_em + 184
draw.rectangle([M, y_kn, W-M, y_kn+2], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_kn += 30

key_nums = [("30","Languages Tracked"),("36.21%","Top Language Share"),("6-mo","Smoothing Window"),("100%","Normalized Total")]
knc = (W-2*M)//4
for i,(val,label) in enumerate(key_nums):
    kx = M + i*knc
    tc(kx+knc//2, y_kn, val, f_key_num, BLUE)
    tc(kx+knc//2, y_kn+100, label, f_key_label, GRAY_DIM)

# ===== PULL QUOTE =====
y_q = y_kn + 168
draw.rectangle([M, y_q, W-M, y_q+1], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_q += 28
# blue vertical accent bar
draw.rectangle([M+40, y_q+4, M+46, y_q+72], fill=BLUE)
draw.text((M+68, y_q+6), "\"Python alone accounts for more than a third of all programming", font=f_quote, fill=GRAY)
draw.text((M+68, y_q+46), "tutorial searches \u2014 nearly triple the share of its closest competitor.\"", font=f_quote, fill=GRAY)

# ===== METHODOLOGY =====
y_meth = y_q + 120
draw.rectangle([M, y_meth, W-M, y_meth+1], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_meth += 16

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PYPL Programming Language Popularity Index — April 2026 poster. v3 final."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math

W, H = 2400, 3600
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#0B0F1A")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

FONTS = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

BG_CARD  = "#111827"
BG_ROW1  = "#141B2D"
BG_ROW2  = "#0F1523"
BLUE     = "#3B82F6"
BLUE_DIM = "#1E3A5F"
BLUE_VDK = "#0F2340"
GREEN    = "#22C55E"
RED      = "#EF4444"
WHITE    = "#F1F5F9"
GRAY     = "#94A3B8"
GRAY_DIM = "#475569"
ACCENT   = "#60A5FA"

def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FONTS}/{name}", size)

f_hero_title = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 148)
f_title      = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 92)
f_subtitle   = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
f_stat_big   = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 120)
f_stat_ctx   = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_rank_num   = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_lang       = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48)
f_share      = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 48)
f_trend      = font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_section    = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 58)
f_section_sm = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_small      = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_tiny       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 23)
f_date       = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_emg_val    = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_emg_label  = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 34)
f_emg_note   = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_5yr_num    = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_5yr_lang   = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)
f_mover_name = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_mover_val  = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 32)
f_key_num    = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 96)
f_key_label  = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_col_hdr    = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_method     = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 25)
f_quote      = font("InstrumentSerif-Italic.ttf", 36)

M = 120  # margin

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill)

def tr(x, y, txt, f, fill=WHITE):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=f)
    draw.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0]), y), txt, font=f, fill=fill)

def tc(cx, y, txt, f, fill=WHITE):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=f)
    draw.text((cx - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y), txt, font=f, fill=fill)

def tcol(v):
    return GREEN if v > 0 else RED if v < 0 else GRAY

def ts(v):
    return f"+{v}%" if v > 0 else f"{v}%"

# ===== SUBTLE BACKGROUND GRID =====
for gx in range(0, W, 120):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill="#0D1220", width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 120):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill="#0D1220", width=1)

# ===== TOP ACCENT =====
for x in range(W):
    t = x / W
    r = int(59 * (1-t) + 34 * t)
    g = int(130 * (1-t) + 197 * t)
    b = int(246 * (1-t) + 94 * t)
    draw.rectangle([x, 0, x+1, 6], fill=f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}")

# ===== HEADER =====
y = 48
draw.text((M, y), "PYPL", font=f_hero_title, fill=BLUE)
bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), "PYPL", font=f_hero_title)
px = M + (bb[2]-bb[0]) + 28
draw.text((px, y + 10), "PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE", font=f_title, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((px, y + 100), "POPULARITY INDEX", font=f_title, fill=WHITE)
tr(W - M, y + 10, "APRIL 2026", f_date, ACCENT)
tr(W - M, y + 50, "WORLDWIDE DATA", f_tiny, GRAY_DIM)

y_sep = 270
draw.rectangle([M, y_sep, W - M, y_sep + 2], fill=BLUE_DIM)
draw.text((M, y_sep + 18), "Google Trends tutorial search share \u2014 a leading indicator of language adoption", font=f_subtitle, fill=GRAY)

# ===== HERO STAT CARDS =====
y_hero = 350
card_w = (W - 2*M - 60) // 3
cards = [
    ("PYTHON", "36.21%", "+5.7% YoY", GREEN, "#1 WORLDWIDE"),
    ("C/C++",  "13.21%", "+6.2% YoY", GREEN, "#2 WORLDWIDE"),
    ("JAVA",   "10.01%", "\u22125.4% YoY", RED,   "#3 WORLDWIDE"),
]

for i, (name, val, trend, col, rank) in enumerate(cards):
    cx = M + i * (card_w + 30)
    rr(cx, y_hero, card_w, 290, 16, BG_CARD)
    # glow accent
    for g in range(6):
        alpha = 40 - g * 6
        draw.rectangle([cx+8, y_hero+g, cx+card_w-8, y_hero+g+1], fill=col+f"{alpha:02x}")
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+24), rank, font=f_tiny, fill=GRAY_DIM)
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+54), name, font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+130), val, font=f_stat_big, fill=col)
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+248), trend, font=f_stat_ctx, fill=col)

# ===== TOP 10 TABLE =====
y_t = y_hero + 340
draw.text((M, y_t), "TOP 10 LANGUAGES", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((M + 520, y_t + 12), "BY SEARCH SHARE", font=f_body, fill=GRAY_DIM)

y_hdr = y_t + 76
draw.text((M+12, y_hdr), "#", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M+85, y_hdr), "LANGUAGE", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M+520, y_hdr), "SHARE", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M+790, y_hdr), "DISTRIBUTION", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
tr(W-M-18, y_hdr, "1Y TREND", f_col_hdr, GRAY_DIM)
draw.rectangle([M, y_hdr+36, W-M, y_hdr+37], fill=BLUE_DIM)

data = [
    (1,"Python",36.21,5.7),(2,"C/C++",13.21,6.2),(3,"Java",10.01,-5.4),
    (4,"R",6.17,1.6),(5,"JavaScript",5.07,-3.0),(6,"Swift",3.15,0.8),
    (7,"C#",3.00,-3.0),(8,"Rust",2.98,-0.1),(9,"PHP",2.96,-0.7),
    (10,"Objective-C",2.57,0.1),
]

row_h = 82
bar_max = 520
y_row = y_hdr + 48

for rank, lang, share, trend in data:
    bg = BG_ROW1 if rank % 2 == 1 else BG_ROW2
    rr(M, y_row, W-2*M, row_h-6, 10, bg)
    c = tcol(trend)
    # left accent
    draw.rectangle([M, y_row+8, M+4, y_row+row_h-14], fill=c)
    draw.text((M+18, y_row+14), f"{rank:>2}", font=f_rank_num, fill=GRAY_DIM)
    draw.text((M+95, y_row+14), lang, font=f_lang, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((M+500, y_row+16), f"{share:.2f}%", font=f_share, fill=WHITE)
    # bar
    bw = int((share/36.21)*bar_max)
    bx, by, bh = M+780, y_row+22, 34
    rr(bx, by, bar_max, bh, 7, "#1a2236")
    if bw > 14:
        rr(bx, by, bw, bh, 7, c+"35")
        draw.rectangle([bx+3, by+3, bx+bw-3, by+bh-3], fill=c+"60")
        draw.rectangle([bx+bw-4, by+4, bx+bw-1, by+bh-4], fill=c+"cc")
    tr(W-M-18, y_row+18, ts(trend), f_trend, c)
    y_row += row_h

y_post_table = y_row + 14
draw.rectangle([M, y_post_table, W-M, y_post_table+2], fill=BLUE_DIM)

# ===== 5-YEAR SPOTLIGHT =====
y5 = y_post_table + 30
draw.text((M, y5), "5-YEAR TREND SPOTLIGHT", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
y5c = y5 + 78
hw = (W-2*M-50)//2

for i, (title, lang, val, col, desc) in enumerate([
    ("BIGGEST 5-YEAR GAINER", "C/C++", "+7.0%", GREEN, "Largest cumulative growth of any tracked language"),
    ("BIGGEST 5-YEAR LOSER", "JAVA", "\u22127.0%", RED, "Steepest cumulative decline of any tracked language"),
]):
    cx = M + i * (hw + 50)
    rr(cx, y5c, hw, 200, 16, BG_CARD)
    for g in range(5):
        a = 35 - g*6
        draw.rectangle([cx+8, y5c+g, cx+hw-8, y5c+g+1], fill=col+f"{a:02x}")
    draw.text((cx+30, y5c+22), title, font=f_tiny, fill=GRAY_DIM)
    draw.text((cx+30, y5c+56), lang, font=f_5yr_lang, fill=WHITE)
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), lang, font=f_5yr_lang)
    draw.text((cx+40+(bb[2]-bb[0]), y5c+56), val, font=f_5yr_num, fill=col)
    draw.text((cx+30, y5c+150), desc, font=f_small, fill=GRAY)

# ===== BIGGEST MOVERS =====
y_gl = y5c + 240
draw.text((M, y_gl), "BIGGEST MOVERS", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((M+430, y_gl+12), "YEAR-OVER-YEAR CHANGE", font=f_body, fill=GRAY_DIM)

movers = [("C/C++",6.2),("Python",5.7),("R",1.6),("Ada",1.1),("Swift",0.8)]
losers = [("Java",-5.4),("JavaScript",-3.0),("C#",-3.0),("Go",-1.3),("Kotlin",-0.9)]

y_mv = y_gl + 72
chw = (W-2*M-60)//2
lx2 = M + chw + 60
draw.text((M+12, y_mv), "GAINERS", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GREEN)
draw.text((lx2+12, y_mv), "LOSERS", font=f_col_hdr, fill=RED)

ym = y_mv + 40
for i in range(5):
    gn, gv = movers[i]
    bw = int((gv/6.2)*(chw-260))
    rr(M, ym-4, chw, 48, 8, BG_ROW1)
    draw.text((M+14, ym+4), gn, font=f_mover_name, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((M+180, ym+4), f"+{gv}%", font=f_mover_val, fill=GREEN)
    rr(M+290, ym+10, bw, 24, 5, GREEN+"44")
    draw.rectangle([M+292, ym+13, M+290+bw-2, ym+31], fill=GREEN+"77")

    ln, lv = losers[i]
    bw2 = int((abs(lv)/6.2)*(chw-260))
    rr(lx2, ym-4, chw, 48, 8, BG_ROW1)
    draw.text((lx2+14, ym+4), ln, font=f_mover_name, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((lx2+180, ym+4), f"{lv}%", font=f_mover_val, fill=RED)
    rr(lx2+290, ym+10, bw2, 24, 5, RED+"44")
    draw.rectangle([lx2+292, ym+13, lx2+290+bw2-2, ym+31], fill=RED+"77")
    ym += 56

# ===== LANGUAGES TO WATCH =====
y_w = ym + 30
draw.rectangle([M, y_w, W-M, y_w+2], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_w += 24
draw.text((M, y_w), "LANGUAGES TO WATCH", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)

emerging = [
    ("Ada","2.51%","+1.1%","Safety-critical systems"),
    ("Julia","0.73%","+0.4%","Scientific computing"),

    ("Kotlin","0.90%","-0.9%","Android-backed decline"),
    ("Zig","0.24%","+0.0%","Niche systems language"),
]

y_em = y_w + 76
ecw = (W-2*M-80)//5
for i,(lang,share,trend,note) in enumerate(emerging):
    ex = M + i*(ecw+20)
    rr(ex, y_em, ecw, 140, 12, BG_CARD)

    draw.ellipse([ex+16, y_em+18, ex+28, y_em+30], fill=c)

    draw.text((ex+18, y_em+96), note, font=f_emg_note, fill=GRAY_DIM)

# ===== KEY NUMBERS =====
y_kn = y_em + 184
draw.rectangle([M, y_kn, W-M, y_kn+2], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_kn += 30

key_nums = [("30","Languages Tracked"),("36.21%","Top Language Share"),("6-mo","Smoothing Window"),("100%","Normalized Total")]
knc = (W-2*M)//4
for i,(val,label) in enumerate(key_nums):
    kx = M + i*knc
    tc(kx+knc//2, y_kn, val, f_key_num, BLUE)
    tc(kx+knc//2, y_kn+100, label, f_key_label, GRAY_DIM)

# ===== PULL QUOTE =====
y_q = y_kn + 168
draw.rectangle([M, y_q, W-M, y_q+1], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_q += 28
# blue vertical accent bar
draw.rectangle([M+40, y_q+4, M+46, y_q+72], fill=BLUE)
draw.text((M+68, y_q+6), "\"Python alone accounts for more than a third of all programming", font=f_quote, fill=GRAY)
draw.text((M+68, y_q+46), "tutorial searches \u2014 nearly triple the share of its closest competitor.\"", font=f_quote, fill=GRAY)

# ===== METHODOLOGY =====

raw_arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PYPL Programming Language Popularity Index — April 2026 poster. v3 final."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math

W, H = 2400, 3600
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#0B0F1A")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

FONTS = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

BG_CARD  = "#111827"
BG_ROW1  = "#141B2D"
BG_ROW2  = "#0F1523"
BLUE     = "#3B82F6"
BLUE_DIM = "#1E3A5F"
BLUE_VDK = "#0F2340"
GREEN    = "#22C55E"
RED      = "#EF4444"
WHITE    = "#F1F5F9"
GRAY     = "#94A3B8"
GRAY_DIM = "#475569"
ACCENT   = "#60A5FA"

def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FONTS}/{name}", size)

f_hero_title = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 148)
f_title      = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 92)
f_subtitle   = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
f_stat_big   = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 120)
f_stat_ctx   = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_rank_num   = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_lang       = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 48)
f_share      = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 48)
f_trend      = font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_section    = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 58)
f_section_sm = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_small      = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_tiny       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 23)
f_date       = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_emg_val    = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
f_emg_label  = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 34)
f_emg_note   = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_5yr_num    = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_5yr_lang   = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)
f_mover_name = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_mover_val  = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 32)
f_key_num    = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 96)
f_key_label  = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_col_hdr    = font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_method     = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 25)
f_quote      = font("InstrumentSerif-Italic.ttf", 36)

M = 120  # margin

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill)

def tr(x, y, txt, f, fill=WHITE):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=f)
    draw.text((x - (bb[2]-bb[0]), y), txt, font=f, fill=fill)

def tc(cx, y, txt, f, fill=WHITE):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=f)
    draw.text((cx - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, y), txt, font=f, fill=fill)

def tcol(v):
    return GREEN if v > 0 else RED if v < 0 else GRAY

def ts(v):
    return f"+{v}%" if v > 0 else f"{v}%"

# ===== SUBTLE BACKGROUND GRID =====
for gx in range(0, W, 120):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill="#0D1220", width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 120):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill="#0D1220", width=1)

# ===== TOP ACCENT =====
for x in range(W):
    t = x / W
    r = int(59 * (1-t) + 34 * t)
    g = int(130 * (1-t) + 197 * t)
    b = int(246 * (1-t) + 94 * t)
    draw.rectangle([x, 0, x+1, 6], fill=f"#{r:02x}{g:02x}{b:02x}")

# ===== HEADER =====
y = 48
draw.text((M, y), "PYPL", font=f_hero_title, fill=BLUE)
bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), "PYPL", font=f_hero_title)
px = M + (bb[2]-bb[0]) + 28
draw.text((px, y + 10), "PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE", font=f_title, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((px, y + 100), "POPULARITY INDEX", font=f_title, fill=WHITE)
tr(W - M, y + 10, "APRIL 2026", f_date, ACCENT)
tr(W - M, y + 50, "WORLDWIDE DATA", f_tiny, GRAY_DIM)

y_sep = 270
draw.rectangle([M, y_sep, W - M, y_sep + 2], fill=BLUE_DIM)
draw.text((M, y_sep + 18), "Google Trends tutorial search share \u2014 a leading indicator of language adoption", font=f_subtitle, fill=GRAY)

# ===== HERO STAT CARDS =====
y_hero = 350
card_w = (W - 2*M - 60) // 3
cards = [
    ("PYTHON", "36.21%", "+5.7% YoY", GREEN, "#1 WORLDWIDE"),
    ("C/C++",  "13.21%", "+6.2% YoY", GREEN, "#2 WORLDWIDE"),
    ("JAVA",   "10.01%", "\u22125.4% YoY", RED,   "#3 WORLDWIDE"),
]

for i, (name, val, trend, col, rank) in enumerate(cards):
    cx = M + i * (card_w + 30)
    rr(cx, y_hero, card_w, 290, 16, BG_CARD)
    # glow accent
    for g in range(6):
        alpha = 40 - g * 6
        draw.rectangle([cx+8, y_hero+g, cx+card_w-8, y_hero+g+1], fill=col+f"{alpha:02x}")
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+24), rank, font=f_tiny, fill=GRAY_DIM)
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+54), name, font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+130), val, font=f_stat_big, fill=col)
    draw.text((cx+30, y_hero+248), trend, font=f_stat_ctx, fill=col)

# ===== TOP 10 TABLE =====
y_t = y_hero + 340
draw.text((M, y_t), "TOP 10 LANGUAGES", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((M + 520, y_t + 12), "BY SEARCH SHARE", font=f_body, fill=GRAY_DIM)

y_hdr = y_t + 76
draw.text((M+12, y_hdr), "#", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M+85, y_hdr), "LANGUAGE", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M+520, y_hdr), "SHARE", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M+790, y_hdr), "DISTRIBUTION", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GRAY_DIM)
tr(W-M-18, y_hdr, "1Y TREND", f_col_hdr, GRAY_DIM)
draw.rectangle([M, y_hdr+36, W-M, y_hdr+37], fill=BLUE_DIM)

data = [
    (1,"Python",36.21,5.7),(2,"C/C++",13.21,6.2),(3,"Java",10.01,-5.4),
    (4,"R",6.17,1.6),(5,"JavaScript",5.07,-3.0),(6,"Swift",3.15,0.8),
    (7,"C#",3.00,-3.0),(8,"Rust",2.98,-0.1),(9,"PHP",2.96,-0.7),
    (10,"Objective-C",2.57,0.1),
]

row_h = 82
bar_max = 520
y_row = y_hdr + 48

for rank, lang, share, trend in data:
    bg = BG_ROW1 if rank % 2 == 1 else BG_ROW2
    rr(M, y_row, W-2*M, row_h-6, 10, bg)
    c = tcol(trend)
    # left accent
    draw.rectangle([M, y_row+8, M+4, y_row+row_h-14], fill=c)
    draw.text((M+18, y_row+14), f"{rank:>2}", font=f_rank_num, fill=GRAY_DIM)
    draw.text((M+95, y_row+14), lang, font=f_lang, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((M+500, y_row+16), f"{share:.2f}%", font=f_share, fill=WHITE)
    # bar
    bw = int((share/36.21)*bar_max)
    bx, by, bh = M+780, y_row+22, 34
    rr(bx, by, bar_max, bh, 7, "#1a2236")
    if bw > 14:
        rr(bx, by, bw, bh, 7, c+"35")
        draw.rectangle([bx+3, by+3, bx+bw-3, by+bh-3], fill=c+"60")
        draw.rectangle([bx+bw-4, by+4, bx+bw-1, by+bh-4], fill=c+"cc")
    tr(W-M-18, y_row+18, ts(trend), f_trend, c)
    y_row += row_h

y_post_table = y_row + 14
draw.rectangle([M, y_post_table, W-M, y_post_table+2], fill=BLUE_DIM)

# ===== 5-YEAR SPOTLIGHT =====
y5 = y_post_table + 30
draw.text((M, y5), "5-YEAR TREND SPOTLIGHT", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
y5c = y5 + 78
hw = (W-2*M-50)//2

for i, (title, lang, val, col, desc) in enumerate([
    ("BIGGEST 5-YEAR GAINER", "C/C++", "+7.0%", GREEN, "Largest cumulative growth of any tracked language"),
    ("BIGGEST 5-YEAR LOSER", "JAVA", "\u22127.0%", RED, "Steepest cumulative decline of any tracked language"),
]):
    cx = M + i * (hw + 50)
    rr(cx, y5c, hw, 200, 16, BG_CARD)
    for g in range(5):
        a = 35 - g*6
        draw.rectangle([cx+8, y5c+g, cx+hw-8, y5c+g+1], fill=col+f"{a:02x}")
    draw.text((cx+30, y5c+22), title, font=f_tiny, fill=GRAY_DIM)
    draw.text((cx+30, y5c+56), lang, font=f_5yr_lang, fill=WHITE)
    bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), lang, font=f_5yr_lang)
    draw.text((cx+40+(bb[2]-bb[0]), y5c+56), val, font=f_5yr_num, fill=col)
    draw.text((cx+30, y5c+150), desc, font=f_small, fill=GRAY)

# ===== BIGGEST MOVERS =====
y_gl = y5c + 240
draw.text((M, y_gl), "BIGGEST MOVERS", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)
draw.text((M+430, y_gl+12), "YEAR-OVER-YEAR CHANGE", font=f_body, fill=GRAY_DIM)

movers = [("C/C++",6.2),("Python",5.7),("R",1.6),("Ada",1.1),("Swift",0.8)]
losers = [("Java",-5.4),("JavaScript",-3.0),("C#",-3.0),("Go",-1.3),("Kotlin",-0.9)]

y_mv = y_gl + 72
chw = (W-2*M-60)//2
lx2 = M + chw + 60
draw.text((M+12, y_mv), "GAINERS", font=f_col_hdr, fill=GREEN)
draw.text((lx2+12, y_mv), "LOSERS", font=f_col_hdr, fill=RED)

ym = y_mv + 40
for i in range(5):
    gn, gv = movers[i]
    bw = int((gv/6.2)*(chw-260))
    rr(M, ym-4, chw, 48, 8, BG_ROW1)
    draw.text((M+14, ym+4), gn, font=f_mover_name, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((M+180, ym+4), f"+{gv}%", font=f_mover_val, fill=GREEN)
    rr(M+290, ym+10, bw, 24, 5, GREEN+"44")
    draw.rectangle([M+292, ym+13, M+290+bw-2, ym+31], fill=GREEN+"77")

    ln, lv = losers[i]
    bw2 = int((abs(lv)/6.2)*(chw-260))
    rr(lx2, ym-4, chw, 48, 8, BG_ROW1)
    draw.text((lx2+14, ym+4), ln, font=f_mover_name, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((lx2+180, ym+4), f"{lv}%", font=f_mover_val, fill=RED)
    rr(lx2+290, ym+10, bw2, 24, 5, RED+"44")
    draw.rectangle([lx2+292, ym+13, lx2+290+bw2-2, ym+31], fill=RED+"77")
    ym += 56

# ===== LANGUAGES TO WATCH =====
y_w = ym + 30
draw.rectangle([M, y_w, W-M, y_w+2], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_w += 24
draw.text((M, y_w), "LANGUAGES TO WATCH", font=f_section, fill=WHITE)

emerging = [
    ("Ada","2.51%","+1.1%","Safety-critical systems"),
    ("Julia","0.73%","+0.4%","Scientific computing"),
    ("Go","0.71%","-1.3%","Cloud-native declining"),
    ("Kotlin","0.90%","-0.9%","Android-backed decline"),
    ("Zig","0.24%","+0.0%","Niche systems language"),
]

y_em = y_w + 76
ecw = (W-2*M-80)//5
for i,(lang,share,trend,note) in enumerate(emerging):
    ex = M + i*(ecw+20)
    rr(ex, y_em, ecw, 140, 12, BG_CARD)
    c = GREEN if "+" in trend and trend!="+0.0%" else RED if "-" in trend else GRAY
    draw.ellipse([ex+16, y_em+18, ex+28, y_em+30], fill=c)
    draw.text((ex+36, y_em+12), lang, font=f_emg_label, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((ex+18, y_em+56), share, font=f_emg_val, fill=ACCENT)
    tr(ex+ecw-18, y_em+56, trend, f_emg_val, c)
    draw.text((ex+18, y_em+96), note, font=f_emg_note, fill=GRAY_DIM)

# ===== KEY NUMBERS =====
y_kn = y_em + 184
draw.rectangle([M, y_kn, W-M, y_kn+2], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_kn += 30

key_nums = [("30","Languages Tracked"),("36.21%","Top Language Share"),("6-mo","Smoothing Window"),("100%","Normalized Total")]
knc = (W-2*M)//4
for i,(val,label) in enumerate(key_nums):
    kx = M + i*knc
    tc(kx+knc//2, y_kn, val, f_key_num, BLUE)
    tc(kx+knc//2, y_kn+100, label, f_key_label, GRAY_DIM)

# ===== PULL QUOTE =====
y_q = y_kn + 168
draw.rectangle([M, y_q, W-M, y_q+1], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_q += 28
# blue vertical accent bar
draw.rectangle([M+40, y_q+4, M+46, y_q+72], fill=BLUE)
draw.text((M+68, y_q+6), "\"Python alone accounts for more than a third of all programming", font=f_quote, fill=GRAY)
draw.text((M+68, y_q+46), "tutorial searches \u2014 nearly triple the share of its closest competitor.\"", font=f_quote, fill=GRAY)

# ===== METHODOLOGY =====
y_meth = y_q + 120
draw.rectangle([M, y_meth, W-M, y_meth+1], fill=BLUE_DIM)
y_meth += 16
draw.text((M, y_meth), "METHODOLOGY", font=f_section_sm, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M, y_meth+52), "PYPL measures Google Trends tutorial search frequency, normalized to 100% with 6-month smoothing. Unlike TIOBE (existing", font=f_method, fill=GRAY_DIM)
draw.text((M, y_meth+84), "web pages), PYPL captures search intent \u2014 what developers are actively learning. A forward-looking measure of momentum.", font=f_method, fill=GRAY_DIM)

# ===== FOOTER =====

    b = int(246*(1-t)+94*t)

Excellent — the poster now fills the canvas well with a clear visual hierarchy. All sections are present: hero stats, the top 10 table as centerpiece, 5-year spotlight, gainers/losers, languages to watch, key numbers, pull quote, and methodology. The dark-mode aesthetic with green/red trend coding works cleanly.

The poster is saved at `/app/output/final_poster.png` (2400×3600px, 300 DPI) alongside the design philosophy at `/app/output/design_philosophy.md`.
